Hi Sarah / ZenFiber procurement team,

Quick one — your onboarding ticket (Zen-1123) shows two provisional PO numbers were issued for the same SKU set and our ledger rejected the activation because the PO prefix and spendband metadata don't match. The billing team flagged a spendcap mismatch and put a temporary hold on provisioning.

Can you confirm whether those two POs are intended (separate legal entities or split spend bands) or if they were created in error? If it was an error, please share the clean SKU list you want us to attach to a single PO and the preferred spend cap.

To move faster, attaching our onboarding checklist would help (I can send a filled copy). If you prefer, we can lift the hold temporarily while you confirm, but procurement needs to sign off first (finance will need the spendcap confirmation).

Next steps I propose:
- ZenFiber confirms single PO vs two POs and preferred spend cap (reply)
- Redwood procurement (cc'd Priyom) to request hold-lift with finance if ZenFiber asks for temporary activation
- If duplicate SKUs, Sarah to return a deduped CSV so we can update the mapping and re-issue the canonical PO

Thanks — I want to avoid creating orphaned ledger lines.

-Markus

Hi Markus — thanks for the flag. Apologies — this was a human issue on our side. We ran two near-identical supplier onboarding forms during the intake week and both generated provisional PO numbers: ZF-00088 and ZF-00089. They reference the same SKU universe (ZEN-CORE-A / ZEN-CORE-B), but one has a legacy vendor prefix in the PO metadata which looks like it caused the mismatch.

We would like you to:
1) Cancel ZF-00089 and consolidate to ZF-00088 (if possible)
2) Accept the attached deduped SKU file and re-issue a single canonical PO mapping to ZF-00088
3) If a temporary hold-lift is needed, we can confirm spendcap up to $75k to get staging capacity unblocked — Tim Hart (cc'd) approved this verbally and will follow up with a signed confirmation this afternoon.

Attachment: zen_dedup_skus.csv (we'll also upload the onboarding form to your Drive link)

Appreciate the quick turnaround. If you need a signed amendment for the spendcap bump, let us know and we'll get Legal involved.

Best,
